title: Jimenez, Diaz make weight for GAB minimumweight title clash in Fist of Fury 13

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – Cebuano boxer John Kevien Jimenez and challenger Carlo Diaz VII successfully made weight ahead of their battle for the vacant Philippine Games and Amusements Board (GAB) minimumweight title in the “Fist of Fury 13” boxing event on Saturday, November 14, at Fuente Osmeña Circle in uptown Cebu City. Jimenez, a standout of Chao Sy Boxing Stable, tipped the scales at 47.49 kilograms, while Diaz weighed in at 46.90 kg during Friday’s official weigh-in. Jimenez (10-5, 5 KOs) expressed confidence in capturing the championship against Diaz (9-4-1, 1 KO) in the main event of the open-air boxing card […]...
